#Setup subject data
```{r Laod data}
#I've used 4 sessions per person, each consisting of 7 full days of actigraphy, can change if you'd like more/less
min_sessions <- 4
min_days     <- 7
#load paths to datasets, downloaded from nsrr
actigraphy_path  <- #TO:DO Update this path to your directory ("your_path_here")
demographix_path <- #TO:DO Update this path to your directory ("your_path_here")
df          <- read.csv(actigraphy_path)
demographix <- read.csv(demographix_path)
to_min <- function(time_str) {
  parts <- strsplit(time_str, ":")
  sapply(parts, function(p) {
    as.numeric(p[1]) * 60 + as.numeric(p[2])
  })
}
#function for dealing with time as a circular construct as linear means won't return correct vals.
circular_sd_hr <- function(x_min) {
  x_min <- x_min[!is.na(x_min)] 
  if (length(x_min) < 2) return(NA_real_) #ensure calc doesn't fail on missing data
  ang <- circular((x_min %% 1440) / 1440 * 2*pi, units = "radians", template = "clock24") #convert to rads
  as.numeric(sd.circular(ang)) * (24 / (2*pi))
}

#Flag sessions with sufficient nights and DLMO
session_night_counts <- df %>%
  group_by(id, session) %>%
  summarise(
    n_nights     = n(),
    has_midsleep = sum(!is.na(mid)) >= min_days,
    .groups      = "drop"
  )

dlmo_availability <- demographix %>%
  mutate(id = as.character(id), session = as.character(session)) %>%
  #keep only these bits from demographix
  select(id, session, DLMO = dlmo) %>%
  #new col to identify missing dlmo's
  mutate(has_dlmo = !is.na(DLMO))

valid_sessions <- session_night_counts %>%
  mutate(id = as.character(id), session = as.character(session)) %>%
  left_join(dlmo_availability, by = c("id", "session")) %>%
  filter(n_nights >= min_days, has_midsleep, has_dlmo) %>%
  select(id, session, n_nights)

#Retain first 4 valid sessions per subject, sorting needs to be done per-participant not globally
eligible_sessions <- valid_sessions %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  arrange(session, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  #rank existing participant sessions
  mutate(session_rank = row_number()) %>%
  filter(session_rank <= min_sessions) %>%
  ungroup()
#Keep only subjects with  4 sessions
eligible_subjects <- eligible_sessions %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(n_valid = n()) %>%
  filter(n_valid == min_sessions) %>%
  pull(id)
#only keep participants who meet participant level criteria
eligible_sessions <- eligible_sessions %>%
  filter(id %in% eligible_subjects)

#Build night-level dataset (first 7 nights per session)
analysis_df <- df %>%
  mutate(id = as.character(id), session = as.character(session)) %>%
  semi_join(eligible_sessions, by = c("id", "session")) %>%
  group_by(id, session) %>%
  arrange(days_numbersincesessiononestart, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = min_days) %>%
  ungroup() %>% #don't need most of these so can drop as needed
  select(id, session, days_numbersincesessiononestart, sday, stime, etime, mid, dur, seff, waso) %>%
  left_join(
    demographix %>%
      mutate(id = as.character(id), session = as.character(session)) %>%
      select(id, session, DLMO = dlmo, agey, agedec_stdate, female_yesno,
             tannerph, rcmas_sum, cesd_tot2, bdi_score2, smith_tot2, rutter_total, season, height_physexam , weight_physexam, race,  shs_pubertal_category2),
    by = c("id", "session")
  )
```
#Session level segreation 
```{r Segregate}
#Convert time to minutes and hours from form data was downloaded in (mins) 
analysis_df <- analysis_df %>%
  mutate(
    onset_min    = to_min(stime),
    offset_min   = to_min(etime),
    midsleep_min = to_min(mid),
    duration_hr  = dur / 60,
    onset_hr     = onset_min / 60,
    offset_hr    = offset_min / 60,
    midsleep_hr  = midsleep_min / 60
  )

#Assign cohort based on baseline age
cohort_map <- analysis_df %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  arrange(session) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>% # get earliest session per participant 
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(cohort = ifelse(agey >= 9 & agey <= 11, "Younger", "Older")) %>% #can change   these depending upon what way you'd like to separate cohorts. 
  select(id, cohort)

#Compute phase angle and day type at night level
night_df <- analysis_df %>%
  left_join(cohort_map, by = "id") %>%
  mutate(
    phase_angle_midsleep_min = ((midsleep_min - (DLMO * 60)) %% 1440),
    phase_angle_hr           = phase_angle_midsleep_min / 60,
    day_type                 = ifelse(sday %in% c("Fri", "Sat"), "free", "school"), 
    BMI                      = weight_physexam / (height_physexam^2) * 703) #BMI needs to be converted to kg/m2 but data is in american format (inches/pounds)
#compute cpd and it's components to correlate with midsleep SD 
compute_cpd <- function(analysis_df) {
  analysis_df <- analysis_df %>%
    arrange(days_numbersincesessiononestart)
  #CPD formula taken from https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8503839/#abstract1
  free_day <- c("Fri","Sat")
  
  msf <- mean(analysis_df$midsleep_hr[analysis_df$sday %in% free_day], na.rm = TRUE)
  dur_free <- mean(analysis_df$duration_hr[analysis_df$sday %in% free_day], na.rm = TRUE)
  dur_week <- mean(analysis_df$duration_hr, na.rm = TRUE)
  msfsc <- msf - (dur_free - dur_week) / 2
  
  analysis_df <- analysis_df %>%
    mutate(
      xi = midsleep_hr - msfsc,
      yi = midsleep_hr - lag(midsleep_hr),
      cpd_i = sqrt(xi^2 + yi^2)
    ) %>% 
    filter(!is.na(cpd_i))
  
  tibble(
    cpd = mean(analysis_df$cpd_i, na.rm = TRUE),
    delta_ct_mean = mean(abs(analysis_df$xi), na.rm = TRUE),
    delta_dd_mean = mean(abs(analysis_df$yi), na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

session_cpd <- analysis_df %>%
  group_by(id, session) %>%
  group_modify(~ compute_cpd(.x)) %>%
  ungroup()
#Aggregate to session level, can drop some of these if not needed 
session_df <- night_df %>%
  group_by(id, session, cohort) %>%
  summarise(
    DLMO            = first(DLMO),
    phase_angle_sd  = circular_sd_hr(phase_angle_midsleep_min),
    midsleep_sd     = circular_sd_hr(midsleep_min),
    midsleep_free   = mean(midsleep_hr[day_type == "free"],   na.rm = TRUE),
    midsleep_school = mean(midsleep_hr[day_type == "school"], na.rm = TRUE),
    duration_free   = mean(duration_hr[day_type == "free"], na.rm = TRUE),
    duration_work   = mean(duration_hr[day_type == "school"], na.rm = TRUE),
    bdi             = first(bdi_score2),
    cesd            = first(cesd_tot2),
    rcmas           = first(rcmas_sum),
    puberty_stage   = first(tannerph),
    rutter          = first(rutter_total),
    race            = first(race),
    BMI             = first(BMI),
    smith           = first(smith_tot2),
    age             = first(agedec_stdate),
    duration        = mean(duration_hr, na.rm = TRUE),
    female          = first(female_yesno),
    season          = first(season),
    .groups         = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sjl        = abs(midsleep_free - midsleep_school),
    msfsc      = midsleep_free - (duration_free-duration_work)/2,
    bdi_z      = (bdi  - mean(bdi,  na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(bdi,  na.rm = TRUE),
    cesd_z     = (cesd - mean(cesd, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(cesd, na.rm = TRUE),
    depression = case_when(
      cohort == "Younger" ~ bdi_z,
      cohort == "Older"   ~ cesd_z
    ),
    is_summer  = as.numeric(tolower(trimws(season)) %in% c("summer", "4"))
  ) %>%
  left_join(session_cpd, by = c("id", "session")) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  arrange(session) %>%
  mutate(wave = row_number() - 1) %>%
  ungroup()
cat("Total sessions:", nrow(session_df), "\n")
cat("Subjects:", n_distinct(session_df$id), "\n")
cat("Younger cohort:", sum(session_df$cohort == "Younger") / 4, "\n")
cat("Older cohort:", sum(session_df$cohort == "Older") / 4, "\n")

cor_mat <- session_df %>% #not necesarry for analysis just interesting to note.
  select(phase_angle_sd, sjl, rcmas, smith, age, cpd, is_summer, msfsc, puberty_stage) %>%
  cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs") %>%
  round(3)

#Merge with phase_angle_sd 
session_data <- session_df %>%
  select(id, session, phase_angle_sd) %>%
  left_join(session_cpd, by = c("id", "session"))

#Correlations, use spearman just cause relationships are probably non-normal 
cor(session_data %>% select(phase_angle_sd, cpd, delta_ct_mean, delta_dd_mean), 
    use = "complete.obs", method = "spearman")
#SD-based variability measures per participant per session
sd_df <- night_df %>%
  group_by(id, session, cohort) %>%
  summarise(
    onset_circ_sd_hr    = circular_sd_hr(onset_hr * 60),
    offset_circ_sd_hr   = circular_sd_hr(offset_hr * 60),
    midsleep_circ_sd_hr = circular_sd_hr(midsleep_hr * 60),
    duration_sd_hr      = sd(duration_hr, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups             = "drop"
  )
print(cor_mat)
write.csv(cor_mat, "your path here")
```

```{r demographics}
  filter(cohort == "Younger", wave == 0, female == 1) %>%

#race tabulation
race_by_subject <- session_df %>%
  filter(cohort == "Younger", wave == 0) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    race_cat = dplyr::case_when(
      race == 1 ~ "White",
      race == 2 ~ "Black or African American",
      race == 3 | race == 7 ~ "Hispanic",
      race == 6 ~ "Multiple races",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    race_cat = factor(
      race_cat,
      levels = c(
        "White",
        "Black or African American",
        "Hispanic",
        "Multiple races"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(id = id, race = race, race_cat) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(race_cat, id)
race_tally <- race_by_subject %>%
  dplyr::count(race_cat, name = "n") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(race_cat)
print(race_tally)
```

#ICC
```{r ICC sd}
#Need to compute ICC scores for sd-based metrics and abs values separately 
#Build sd_df from night_df
sd_df <- night_df %>%
  group_by(id, session, cohort) %>%
  summarise(
    phase_angle_sd      = circular_sd_hr(phase_angle_midsleep_min),
    midsleep_circ_sd_hr = circular_sd_hr(midsleep_min),
    onset_circ_sd_hr    = circular_sd_hr(onset_min),
    offset_circ_sd_hr   = circular_sd_hr(offset_min),
    duration_sd_hr      = sd(duration_hr, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups             = "drop"
  )

#Build abs_df from session_df
abs_df <- session_df %>%
  select(id, session, cohort, DLMO, sjl, smith)
#can change the number of bootstraps if needed
calculate_icc <- function(data, variable, nboot = 200) {
  dat <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[variable]])) %>%
    mutate(id = factor(id), session_num = as.numeric(as.character(session)))
  n_obs <- nrow(dat)
  n_ids <- n_distinct(dat$id)
#ensure that there is the appropriate amount of obs
  if (n_obs < 3 || n_ids < 2) {
    return(tibble(
      variable,
      n_obs, n_ids,
      icc_pct     = NA_real_,
      icc_lcl_pct = NA_real_,
      icc_ucl_pct = NA_real_
    ))
  }
#fits mixed-effects model, ri for each participant
  model <- lmer(as.formula(paste(variable, "~ session_num + (1 | id)")),
                data = dat, REML = TRUE)
  #decompose variance into between and within-person components
  vc          <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model))
  var_between <- vc$vcov[vc$grp == "id"]
  var_within  <- sigma(model)^2
  icc         <- var_between / (var_between + var_within)
#same ICC calc to return a single ICC value
  boot_fun <- function(fit) {
    vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(fit))
    vb <- vc$vcov[vc$grp == "id"]
    vw <- sigma(fit)^2
    vb / (vb + vw)
  }
#generate simulated datasets and refit model to simulated dataset and store ICC distribution
  boot_res <- suppressMessages(bootMer(model, boot_fun, nsim = nboot))
  ci        <- try(boot.ci(boot_res, type = "perc"), silent = TRUE)
  lcl       <- if (!inherits(ci, "try-error") && !is.null(ci$percent)) ci$percent[4] else NA_real_
  ucl       <- if (!inherits(ci, "try-error") && !is.null(ci$percent)) ci$percent[5] else NA_real_

  tibble(
    variable, n_obs, n_ids,
    icc_pct     = round(icc * 100, 1),
    icc_lcl_pct = round(lcl * 100, 1),
    icc_ucl_pct = round(ucl * 100, 1)
  )
}
#SD outcomes
sd_outcomes <- c("phase_angle_sd", "midsleep_circ_sd_hr", "onset_circ_sd_hr",
                 "offset_circ_sd_hr", "duration_sd_hr")
icc_sd_younger <- sd_df %>% filter(cohort == "Younger") %>%
  { bind_rows(lapply(sd_outcomes, function(v) calculate_icc(., v))) } %>%
  mutate(cohort = "Younger")
icc_sd_older <- sd_df %>% filter(cohort == "Older") %>%
  { bind_rows(lapply(sd_outcomes, function(v) calculate_icc(., v))) } %>%
  mutate(cohort = "Older")
icc_sd_results <- bind_rows(icc_sd_younger, icc_sd_older) %>%
  relocate(cohort, variable, n_obs, n_ids) %>%
  arrange(cohort, variable)
print(icc_sd_results)

  { bind_rows(lapply(abs_outcomes, function(v) calculate_icc(., v))) } %>%
  mutate(cohort = "Younger")

  relocate(cohort, variable, n_obs, n_ids) %>%
```

#Correlation PA SD and CPD 
```{r SJL vs. PA SD}
#Useful to investigate association between misalignment and phase instability, I like these pastel colours
wave_colours <- c("0" = "#E69F00", "1" = "#56B4E9", "2" = "#009E73", "3" = "#CC79A7")
plot_data <- session_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(phase_angle_sd), !is.na(cpd)) %>%
  #separate into each wave
  mutate(wave = as.factor(wave))
cor_stats <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(wave) %>%
  summarise(
    rho = round(cor(cpd, phase_angle_sd, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"), 3),
    p_val = cor.test(cpd, phase_angle_sd, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    #include pvals and labels
    p_label = ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < .001", paste0("p = ", sprintf("%.3f", p_val))),
    label = paste0("Rho = ", sprintf("%.3f", rho), ", ", p_label)
  )

make_wave_plot <- function(wave_num) {
  this_data <- plot_data %>% filter(wave == as.character(wave_num))
  this_label <- cor_stats %>% filter(wave == as.character(wave_num)) %>% pull(label)
  this_colour <- wave_colours[[as.character(wave_num)]]
  ggplot(this_data, aes(x = cpd, y = phase_angle_sd)) +
    geom_point(size = 2, colour = this_colour, alpha = 0.85) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "black", fill = "grey80", linewidth = 0.7) +
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = this_label, 
             hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.5, size = 5, fontface = "italic") +
    labs(title = paste("Wave", wave_num + 1), 
         x = "Composite Phase Deviation", 
         y = "Phase Angle SD") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 17),
      axis.title.x  = element_text(, face = "bold", size = 14),
      axis.title.y  = element_text(, face = "bold", size = 14),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(colour = "grey70", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5)
    )
}

p1 <- make_wave_plot(1)
```

```{r demog stats}
mwu_vars <- c("age", "BMI", "rutter", "rcmas", "sjl", "DLMO", "duration",
              "phase_angle_sd", "onset_adj", "offset_hr", "seff", "waso",
              "onset_circ_sd_hr", "offset_circ_sd_hr", "midsleep_circ_sd_hr",
              "duration_sd_hr", "puberty_stage", "smith")

run_mwu <- function(var, data) {
  n_young <- sum(!is.na(data[[var]][data$cohort == "Younger"]))
  n_old   <- sum(!is.na(data[[var]][data$cohort == "Older"]))
  res <- tryCatch({
    w <- wilcox.test(data[[var]] ~ data$cohort, exact = FALSE)
    tibble(variable = var, test = "Mann-Whitney U",
           statistic = unname(w$statistic), p_value = w$p.value)
  }, error = function(e) {
    tibble(variable = var, test = "Mann-Whitney U",
           statistic = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_)
  })
  res %>% mutate(n_younger = n_young, n_older = n_old)
}

mwu_results <- bind_rows(lapply(mwu_vars, run_mwu, data = stats_df))
#Fisher's exact (clean 2x2)
sex_tab <- table(stats_df$female, stats_df$cohort)
sex_result <- tibble(
  variable  = "female",
  test      = "Fisher's exact",
  statistic = NA_real_,
  p_value   = fisher.test(sex_tab)$p.value,
  n_younger = sum(stats_df$cohort == "Younger" & !is.na(stats_df$female)),
  n_older   = sum(stats_df$cohort == "Older"   & !is.na(stats_df$female))
)
#Fisher's exact (each category vs rest)
race_tab <- table(stats_df$race_cat, stats_df$cohort)

race_result <- tibble(
  variable  = "race",
  test      = "Fisher's score",
  statistic = NA_real_,
  p_value   = fisher.test(race_tab, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 1e5)$p.value,
  n_younger = sum(stats_df$cohort == "Younger" & !is.na(stats_df$race_cat)),
  n_older   = sum(stats_df$cohort == "Older"   & !is.na(stats_df$race_cat))
)#Combine
table1_tests <- bind_rows(mwu_results, sex_result, race_result)
print(table1_tests, n = Inf)
```
